fact: By decision of 16 January 2025 the regulator ARCEP capped wholesale prices for 2025, cutting the monthly dark-fibre rental ceiling from 75 to 30 FCFA per linear metre so that all operators can access national transmission infrastructure.
title: L'ARCEP encadre à la baisse les tarifs sur le marché de gros
publisher: Autorité de Régulation des Communications Electroniques et des Postes
